package.name: j10_telemetry
package.description: Latency monitoring and dataset capture. latency_monitor_node aggregates per-stage LatencyReport into p50/p95/p99 and judges them against the budget table in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 6 -- this is how the 300 ms end-to-end number gets proven rather than assumed. dataset_recorder_node captures synchronized rosbag2 data for VLA fine-tuning and post-flight review.
